description: Tuples don't unify when an element's object value can't convert to the other's map type
notes: hashicorp/hcl unifies element 0 to a map of strings: the object's attribute types, an empty tuple and the dynamic pseudo-type of null, unify to the dynamic pseudo-type, and a map of that unifies with the map of strings (unifyObjectsAsMaps in cty/convert/unify.go). But the empty tuple can't convert to a string, so the object can't convert to that type, and neither the tuples nor a list of their element types unify (unifyTupleTypes and unifyTupleTypesToList). The spec unifies the element to the object type, which the map's strings can't convert to either.
